start: Member in the app's feedback box, microphone allowed

steps.action: Tap 'Speak', say the feedback in Hindi or English, stop
user_sees: The spoken words as text in the box, to check
must_not: The clip sent before the member stops
Text in another person's words

steps.action: Fix a word and tap 'Send'
user_sees: 'Thanks! We read every message.'
must_not: The clip itself saved anywhere
The fixed text replaced by the first version

steps.action: Record a silent clip
user_sees: 'We heard nothing. Try again, closer to the phone.'
must_not: Empty text put in the box

steps.action: Record more than 2 minutes
user_sees: 'Too long. Keep it under 2 minutes.'
must_not: The clip thrown away so the member must speak again

steps.action: Speak a 21st clip the same day
user_sees: 'You have spoken a lot today. Type your message, or try tomorrow.'
must_not: A clip sent to the speech service past the limit

start: Member speaks while the speech service is busy or switched off

steps.action: Tap Speak and stop
user_sees: 'Too many people are speaking right now. Wait a minute and try again.'
or 'Speaking is not switched on yet. Type your message instead.'
must_not: The clip lost (the app keeps it on every answer but success)

steps.action: Try again a minute later
user_sees: The text in the box
must_not: Two texts pasted in

steps.action: The clip goes through MettleUp's server to the speech service
user_sees: The text back
must_not: The recording or its text kept by MettleUp or the speech service
The count per phone kept over 7 days
